# Starke Fuesse – llms.txt
# This file helps AI assistants understand this website.

## What this website is about
Starke Fuesse (starkefuesse.de) is a German online course platform offering evidence-based functional foot training. The course is designed by Lukas Manfred Heck, a sport rehabilitation trainer, personal trainer and alternative practitioner based in Bühl, Germany.

## The product
- Product: 6-week online foot training course
- Language: German
- Price: 227 EUR (incl. VAT), one-time payment
- Access: 6 months, 24/7, all devices
- Guarantee: 14-day money-back guarantee
- Payment: via Digistore24

## What the course teaches
Functional foot training based on current scientific evidence. The course focuses on:
- Balance training and neuromuscular control
- Targeted strength training (foot, calf, lower leg)
- Daily 5-minute routines
- 2x per week training sessions of 15-20 minutes
- No equipment needed, can be done at home

## Scientific foundation
The course is based on peer-reviewed research:
- Sherrington et al. (Cochrane 2019): Balance and functional training reduces fall rates by up to 24%
- Sherrington et al. (BJSM 2020): Combined balance and strength programs reduce fall rates by ~28%
- Araujo et al. (BJSM 2022): 10-second single-leg stance predicts survival in middle-aged adults
- Jaffri et al. (J Sport Rehabil 2023): Intrinsic foot muscle training improves balance and foot function
- Rathleff et al. (Scand J Med Sci Sports 2015): High-load calf strength training outperforms stretching

## Who the course is for
Adults 40+, health-conscious people, those with first signs of instability, active adults who want to stay mobile and independent. No prior experience required.
